Marriage Biodata Formats by Community & Tradition

A well-structured marriage biodata presents personal, educational, family, and cultural details clearly on a single or two-page layout. Explore our built-in presets tailored for every community:

Hindu Marriage Biodata Format

Begins with an auspicious invocation such as || Shree Ganeshay Namah || or || Om Namah Shivay ||, followed by Personal Details, Vedic Horoscope / Kundli attributes (Time & Place of Birth, Rashi, Nakshatra, Gotra, Manglik status, Gan, Nadi), Education & Career, Family Background, and Contact Details.

Muslim / Nikah Biodata Format

Features Bismillah-ir-Rahman-ir-Rahim (786) and Mughal/Arabesque geometric borders in Emerald, Ivory, and Gold. Includes Personal Profile, Sect / Maslak, Biradari, Religious Practice, Qualification & Profession, Family Background, and Wali / Guardian Contact Details.

Sikh (Anand Karaj) Biodata Format

Opens with the sacred Ik Onkar (ੴ) Satnam Waheguru emblem in Royal Navy & Gold. Focuses on Personal & Gursikh Lifestyle details, Education & Professional Career, Parental & Sibling Details, and Native Place in Punjab or abroad.

Marathi, Gujarati & Regional Formats

Supports regional customs including Kuldaivat / Kuldevi, Devak, Mama's Name (Maternal Uncle), and Relatives' Surnames, with one-click label translation into Marathi (मराठी), Gujarati (ગુજરાતી), Hindi (हिन्दी), Tamil (தமிழ்), Telugu (తెలుగు), Bengali (বাংলা), Kannada (ಕನ್ನಡ), and Urdu (اردو).

Christian, Jain & Buddhist Formats

Includes dedicated templates and sacred symbols for Christian matrimony (Cross emblem, Denomination & Home Parish fields), Jain matrimony (|| Jai Jinendra || with Shwetambar/Digambar & dietary fields), and Buddhist matrimony (|| Namo Buddhaya || with Dharma Wheel motif).

Modern Executive, Magazine, Palace & Kundali Layouts

Designed for professionals, NRIs, and families with detailed horoscopes or extended family trees. Choose from 14 structural engines including Magazine Cover Spread, Palace Darbar Arch, Vedic Kundali Focus, Infographic Resume, Sidebar, Boxed Cards, Timeline Spine, or Dedicated Two-Page A4 layouts.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

Everything you need to know about creating, customizing, and downloading your marriage biodata.

Is this marriage biodata maker completely free with no watermark?

Yes! Every single template (all 242 designs), ceremonial stickers, Vedic Kundali charts, photo frames, and download formats (PDF, Editable Word .docx, PNG, and JPG) are 100% free forever. We never add watermarks across your sheet, never mask letters with asterisks, and never ask for your phone number or credit card.

How does the Editable Microsoft Word (.docx) download work?

When you click Word (.docx), our browser engine constructs a true native Word document with styled section headers, double page borders, your portrait photo, and editable two-column tables so you can freely edit any text later in Microsoft Word, LibreOffice, or Google Docs.

How do the interactive on-canvas editing features work?

You can click directly on any heading, field label, or field value on the live A4 sheet to edit it inline! Open Tab 4 (✨ Studio & Kundali) to drag and drop 24+ sacred & floral stickers, create custom text wax seals or ribbons, insert an interactive North/South/East Indian Vedic Kundali chart, apply silk or mandala paper textures, or use Undo/Redo and Zoom controls on the canvas toolbar.

Are my personal details and photo stored on any server?

No. Unlike other websites that silently upload your draft to cloud storage, our application runs 100% inside your device's web browser. Your data is saved only in your browser's local storage so you can pick up where you left off, and you can clear or export it as a .json backup anytime.

Can I add, rename, reorder, or hide fields and sections?

Yes. Click any section title or field label to rename it inline. Use the ↑ and ↓ buttons to reorder rows, click the eye icon (👁) to hide any field or section (such as Horoscope or Annual Income), or click any + Quick Add pill below a section to add optional fields in one click.

What if I have many fields or want a 2-page comprehensive marriage biodata?

For 1-page templates, our Smart Single-Page Auto-Fit solver automatically scales text and row spacing so your biodata fits cleanly inside one A4 page. If you have extensive family, kundli, and partner expectation details, you can also filter by 2 Pages in the template gallery to pick from 21 dedicated Two-Page Comprehensive A4 templates.

Can I create a marriage biodata without a photo?

Absolutely. Open Tab 2 (Header & Photo) and uncheck Include Photo on Biodata, or filter the gallery by No-Photo Native to choose from 17 templates specifically balanced for text-only matrimonial profiles.
